does_not_prove: It does not discharge the thirteen remaining update/final/ctrl callbacks; they still dereference md_data without a check and are BLOCKED.
It does not make EVP_PKEY_PROVIDER mechanism-wide SAFETY_DISCHARGED.
It does not make either consumer SAFE_COMPATIBLE; the closure still REFUSES.
It does not establish constant-time behaviour, secret cleansing, or cryptographic correctness beyond the known 'abc' vectors.
The closure graph is not stable across the S' -> S'' rebuild: 13 files left and 6 entered the ssh reachable set, so the v1i/v1j counts are not a like-for-like delta.
The census/closure identity is uncommitted; the closure records STALE_HASH for src/evp/legacy_sha.rs against bcafae7dc.
non_claims: SAFETY_DISCHARGED here is site-scoped and contract-bounded.
The probe and receipt share one author; this is not independent review.
No Miri/ASan/Loom/mutation evidence was run at this identity.
